scripts.name: othello-scene.ts

variables.name: discTag
variables.label: Disc tag
variables.description: Only tokens with this tag are discs. Leave empty to treat every token on the table as a disc.

variables.name: blackWhenUpright
variables.label: Black shows when upright
variables.description: Which colour a disc shows when it lies the way its model was made. The reversi-othello disc is black side up.

variables.name: dropHeight
variables.label: Drop height
variables.description: How far above a square (in feet) a bot lets go of a disc.

variables.name: labelDistance
variables.label: Score label distance
variables.description: How far beyond the a-file edge of the squares the score label sits, in squares. Raise it if the board's frame or trays hide the label.

variables.name: blackSeat
variables.label: Black's seat
variables.description: Leave empty: whoever moves first plays Black.
